protocol.purpose: Independent US test of Song et al. (2026), Scenario 1; original proprietary features unavailable
protocol.universe: historical S&P 500 membership on decision date
protocol.feature_definition: 72 explicit descriptors of the seven disclosed minute fields, documented by build_tensors.py
protocol.price_fields: conservative price-eligible TAQ OHLC; no substitution with raw_*
protocol.adjustment: nominal minute price divided by same-day CRSP dlycumfacpr
protocol.missing_features: training-period mean imputation, then standard deviation scaling and clipping to [-10,10]
protocol.missing_labels: masked per horizon; final minute required
protocol.half_days: exclude decision dates with a short input OR next-session label day
protocol.boundary_purge: label date must belong to same split as decision date; allow Aug 1 2025 only for final test labels
protocol.bilevel_update: one differentiable SGD step as Equation 13; write look-ahead parameters into student; AdamW for warmup and final supervised fits
protocol.optimizer_ambiguity: Appendix A.5 says AdamW while Equation 13 specifies a gradient-descent look-ahead; this implementation follows the displayed look-ahead equation explicitly
protocol.selection: validation final-horizon loss for early stopping; argmax learned horizon weight; retrain selected horizon from same seed initialization as standard baseline
protocol.primary_comparison: five-seed standard final-horizon LSTM versus five-seed retrained BLO-selected-horizon LSTM
protocol.statistics: daily Pearson IC, Spearman RankIC, nonannualized ICIR, top-decile gross price return, annualized gross Sharpe; paired date-block bootstrap of IC difference
protocol.test_policy: do not evaluate financial test metrics until all required training/validation data and five-seed fits are complete
